title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.40325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. translated_title: WorldAuditBench：基于多模态智能体的交互式3D世界审计
translated_abstract: 随着交互式3D世界被越来越多地用于研究智能行为，开发高效的流水线来识别这些模拟环境中的异常变得尤为重要，例如悬浮物体、可穿透的墙壁或与周围场景不一致的物体。包括视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在内的多模态AI系统已显示出自动化这一任务的潜力。然而，3D世界审计是复杂的，需要两种不同能力的紧密耦合：动作能力，用于在3D世界中导航并系统、高效地搜索异常；以及视觉推理能力，用于理解环境并从多模态观察中识别异常。多模态智能体能否有效地耦合这两种能力——即利用视觉推理识别潜在异常，同时通过采取行动来验证这些异常——在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们介……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了WorldAuditBench这一交互式3D世界审计基准，用于评估多模态智能体能否将行动导航与视觉推理紧密结合，以系统性地发现并验证模拟3D环境中的异常（如悬浮物体、可穿透墙壁等）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for interactive 3D world auditing that evaluates whether multimodal agents can effectively couple action-based navigation with visual reasoning to systematically detect and validate anomalies in simulated 3D environments, such as floating objects and traversable walls.
